capNote: The league has not set the 2027 or 2028 cap. These are the projections Over The Cap uses for its future cap tables; later years grow by the rate shown.

calendar.label: Trade deadline
calendar.note: Trading ends for 2026 at 4:00 p.m. ET.

calendar.label: Franchise and transition tag window opens
calendar.note: Teams can tag one pending free agent each.

calendar.label: Scouting combine begins
calendar.note: Runs about eight days, ending around March 8.

calendar.label: Negotiating window opens
calendar.note: Noon ET. Teams may talk with agents for other teams' pending free agents but cannot sign them yet.

calendar.label: League year and free agency begin
calendar.note: 4:00 p.m. ET. Contracts can be signed and trades announced.

calendar.label: Restricted free agent offer sheet deadline
calendar.note: Restricted free agents can no longer sign offer sheets with other teams after this date.

calendar.label: NFL Draft begins
calendar.note: April 29 to May 1 in Washington, D.C.

source: Dates: NFL.com 2026-27 important dates, Pro Football Talk and the Buccaneers site. Future caps: Over The Cap.
